laws.rule: The Pyrénées National Park core also covers high valleys in Pyrénées-Atlantiques (Béarn). The same park rules apply there as in Occitania: no camping, bivouac only from 19:00 to 09:00 and more than one hour's walk from the core edge or motor access, no fires, no dogs, and no drone or other motorised flight below 1,000 m. The full wording is held on the Occitania page.

laws.rule: Landes and Gironde (with Lot-et-Garonne) share one forest-fire protection regulation, revised and signed on 7 July 2023 by the three prefects. It governs forest activities, ignition sources, movement in the Landes de Gascogne massif, cycle paths and leisure activities. The prefect sets a vigilance level: green (1 October to end February), yellow (1 March to 30 September), and orange, red or black on particular days. The map is at dfci-aquitaine.fr. The rules for each colour are in posters and a FAQ the Landes prefecture links to; they were not read here.
